clean_room: Use only broad sea-chart readability and responsiveness principles; no proprietary content or timing.

layout.no_tracked_objective: Reuse the existing mission panel for first-sortie next step, hint and observed progress.
layout.tracked_objective: Keep the player-selected quest primary; display a small sortie count only when panel width permits.
layout.narrow_panel: Omit secondary sortie counter. Never overlap quest title or place additional center-chart chrome.

placeholders: Reuse complete stable individual ship GLBs and the external M290 beacon; no new modular asset or separate replacement art per UI context.
